limits: The minor grapes together: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Bergerac appellation in South West France making only sweet white wine, similar to Monbazillac but a little drier. It is generally Sémillon affected by noble rot, and adding sugar is forbidden.
